tagline: Global leader in vaccine development and commercialization with a diverse portfolio spanning travel health, public preparedness, and emerging infectious diseases
hero_kpi_rationale: This KPI reflects the company's sustainable structural performance, driven by the recovery of international travel and the expansion of the travel vaccine portfolio, notably the approval and global launch of Vimkunya (chikungunya vaccine) in 2025, positioning the company as a leader in this strategic segment.

kpis.name: Travel Health Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from vaccines for international travelers, including the new chikungunya vaccine (Vimkunya) launched globally in 2025.
kpis.description: The segment reached a record level in 2025 due to the global launch of Vimkunya and continued recovery in international travel, with 39% growth compared to 2024.
kpis.signal: Record-breaking year driven by Vimkunya global launch and travel recovery

kpis.name: Public Preparedness Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue related to smallpox and mpox vaccines used by governments for biological threat and epidemic preparedness.
kpis.description: The segment reached DKK 3,626 million in 2025, reflecting normalization after the 2023-2024 mpox emergency peak, partially offset by new government contracts (EU and US for 2026).
kpis.signal: Normalisation post-pic mpox 2023-2024, but supported by new government contracts

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total annual revenue of the company.
kpis.description: Total revenue reached DKK 6,244 million in 2025, compared to DKK 7,062 million in 2023, reflecting normalization in the Public Preparedness segment partially offset by record growth in the Travel Health segment.
kpis.signal: Expected decline post-mpox peak in 2023, stabilized by Travel Health growth

kpis.name: EBITDA before special items
kpis.explanation: Operating profit before depreciation, amortization, and special items (e.g., sale of Priority Review Voucher).
kpis.description: EBITDA before special items was DKK 1,743 million in 2025 (28% margin), compared to DKK 2,615 million in 2023, reflecting volume normalization after the mpox crisis while maintaining solid structural profitability.
kpis.signal: Normalization of margins post-mpox peak, maintenance of profitability at 28%

kpis.name: EBITDA margin including special items
kpis.explanation: EBITDA margin after inclusion of special items (notably the sale of the Priority Review Voucher for Vimkunya: DKK 810 million net).
kpis.description: EBITDA margin including special items reached 41% in 2025, supported by the net proceeds of DKK 810 million from the sale of the Priority Review Voucher obtained upon approval of Vimkunya.
kpis.signal: One-off benefit from Vimkunya Priority Review Voucher sale boosting reported profitability

kpis.name: Doses Distributed
kpis.explanation: Total number of vaccine doses sold and distributed globally, including humanitarian donations.
kpis.description: Over 10 million doses were sold and distributed globally in 2025, including 130,000 mpox doses donated to Africa CDC and UNICEF.
kpis.signal: Scale of global vaccine distribution surpassing 10 million doses annually

kpis.name: CO2 Emissions Scope 1+2
kpis.explanation: Total greenhouse gas emissions (Scope 1 and Scope 2, market-based) from own operations.
kpis.description: CO2 emissions (Scope 1 and Scope 2, market-based) decreased by 57% to reach 3,571 tCO2e in 2025 compared to 2024, reflecting environmental sustainability efforts.
kpis.signal: 57% reduction in carbon footprint from 2024 to 2025

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 14.95 Bn € in the latest year

risks.title: Dependence on a single supplier for manufacturing
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned in the 'Risk management' section of the annual report, with moderate to strong language on supply chain intensity. The trend is stable, but the 'Industrial' category is critical for operational continuity.

risks.title: Increased competition in travel vaccines
risks.score_rationale: The risk is implicit in marketing and Vimkunya launch efforts. Affirmative language on differentiation, but competition acknowledged. Trend increasing with entry into new markets.

risks.title: Low awareness of chikungunya
risks.score_rationale: The risk is explicitly mentioned in '2025 in brief' and 'Growing the chikungunya vaccine market'. Strong language on market creation challenges. Trend stable, high weight for Vimkunya's success.

risks.title: Delayed international regulatory approvals
risks.score_rationale: The risk relates to future regulatory approvals (Switzerland, Canada) mentioned in the strategy. Cautious language, stable trend, high weight for geographic expansion.

risks.title: Volatility in public health preparedness demand
risks.score_rationale: The risk is central in the 'Public Preparedness' section and discussed by the CEO. Strong language on unpredictability. Trend stable, critical weight on half of revenue.

risks.title: Cybersecurity of clinical and R&D data
risks.score_rationale: Not explicitly mentioned, but implicit in the management of sensitive R&D and clinical trial data. Neutral language, but underlying risk is high. Trend increasing with digitalization.

risks.title: Dependence on expired commercial partnerships
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in 'Growing the chikungunya vaccine market' with the end of Valneva and Dynavax agreements. Factual language, trend decreasing, but transitional impact on revenue.

risks.title: Protection of vaccine intellectual property
risks.score_rationale: Not explicitly mentioned, but critical for a business model based on vaccine innovation. Implicit language on technological differentiation. Trend stable, high weight.

ai_positioning.summary: Bavarian Nordic does not mention any strategy or technology related to artificial intelligence in its 2025 annual report. The strategy remains focused on vaccines, acquisitions, and commercial partnerships.
evidence: No mention of AI in the 2025 annual report
No reference to AI tools in R&D or commercial operations
Strategy focused on traditional vaccines and global partnerships
